name: Blinded
says: Blinded: can't see and automatically fails any ability check that requires sight; attack rolls against it have advantage and its own attack rolls have disadvantage.
does: Applies both attack bullets (blinded_target advantage, blinded_attacker disadvantage; a blinded creature also gets no Dodge and no opportunity attack). The automatic failure of sight-based ability checks is not applied: a blinded character's check rolls normally.
seen: Master: the "Mudar condições" note says the app applies speed 0 and advantage or disadvantage and the other effects are the master's (RN-22), and the master's effects panel lists the condition with its "O que isso muda" lines (combat_effects.json changes_pt, shown by looseConditions); the condition tag names it to everyone allowed to read it. A player reads only the tag; the "O que isso muda" lines reach a player only when the condition came with an effect row (spell, trap, rider), not when the master ticked it. The roll card lists the blinded source; the changes_pt line says it fails sight checks.

name: Charmed
says: Charmed: can't attack the charmer or target it with harmful abilities or magical effects; the charmer has advantage on social ability checks against it.
does: Applies nothing: no attack or harmful spell is refused against the charmer and no social check gets advantage; the condition is only a tag. RN-22 gives every effect that is not speed 0 or advantage/disadvantage on attack rolls to the master. The sheet's condition immunity and the elf's Fey Ancestry advantage on saves against being charmed do apply.
seen: Master: the "Mudar condições" note says the app applies speed 0 and advantage or disadvantage and the other effects are the master's (RN-22), and the master's effects panel lists the condition with its "O que isso muda" lines (combat_effects.json changes_pt, shown by looseConditions); the condition tag names it to everyone allowed to read it. Owner-class: only the character's player and the master read it.

name: Deafened
says: Deafened: can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.
does: Applies nothing to checks. Only Bardic Inspiration (target must be able to hear) and Danger Sense (not while deafened) read the condition. RN-22 leaves the rest to the master.
seen: Master: the "Mudar condições" note says the app applies speed 0 and advantage or disadvantage and the other effects are the master's (RN-22), and the master's effects panel lists the condition with its "O que isso muda" lines (combat_effects.json changes_pt, shown by looseConditions); the condition tag names it to everyone allowed to read it. Owner-class (RN-22).

name: Frightened
says: Frightened: disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls only while the source of its fear is in line of sight; it can't willingly move closer to the source.
does: Gives disadvantage on every attack roll and every ability check whenever the condition is on, with no sight condition, because the app does not keep who is feared (comment in AttackMode). Not applied: the ban on moving closer. The master can correct the roll through the roll-mode request or his own mode with a reason, not by a switch on the condition.
seen: Master: the "Mudar condições" note says the app applies speed 0 and advantage or disadvantage and the other effects are the master's (RN-22), and the master's effects panel lists the condition with its "O que isso muda" lines (combat_effects.json changes_pt, shown by looseConditions); the condition tag names it to everyone allowed to read it. The roll card lists the frightened source as a plain disadvantage; the changes_pt line says 'enquanto vê a fonte do seu medo'.
fix: Record the source combatant on the condition (condition_sources already exists) and give the frightened sources only when that creature is visible in the fog/vision check; add a move refusal toward it.

name: Grappled
says: Grappled: speed becomes 0 and gets no bonus; ends if the grappler is incapacitated; ends if the grappled creature is removed from the grappler's reach (such as hurled away by thunderwave).
does: Speed 0 is applied for every grappled creature (speedAtDFt). A grapple made with the Grapple action creates a hold row, and pruneHolds ends it after every change when the grappler is incapacitated, defeated, down or farther than 5 ft (map only). A grapple given by an NPC's hit rider, a spell or by hand has no hold row, so it never ends by itself when the grappler is incapacitated or the target is pushed away.
seen: Turn line: 'Você está Agarrado. Deslocamento 0.'; changes_pt: 'Acaba se quem o agarra ficar incapacitado ou se algo o tirar do alcance.'

fix: Make grapplingRider call applyGrapple (hold row) with the attacker as grappler.

name: Incapacitated
says: Incapacitated: can't take actions or reactions.
does: The server refuses every action, bonus action and reaction of an incapacitated combatant (gate/cannotActCode, kit incapacitating), the turn options show them disabled, and it ends the concentration of a caster and the states that end on incapacitation. 'Encerrar turno' stays.
seen: Turn options disabled with 'Você não pode agir.' (the master reads which condition).

name: Invisible
says: Invisible: impossible to see without magic or a special sense; heavily obscured for hiding; location given away by noise or tracks; attack rolls against it have disadvantage and its own have advantage.
does: Applies the attack bullet (invisible_target disadvantage, invisible_attacker advantage; Faerie Fire cancels it) and the unseen-attacker and unseen-target sources skip an invisible creature so nothing counts twice. The sight part is not applied: truesight or See Invisibility does not remove the disadvantage (the SRD text gives it without exception), no heavily obscured hiding, no noise or tracks.

Owner-class (RN-22); the others see nothing of it.

name: Paralyzed
says: Paralyzed: incapacitated, can't move or speak; automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attack rolls against it have advantage; a hit from within 5 ft is a critical hit.
does: Incapacitated and speed 0 are applied (no action, no reaction, no move; with no actions it casts nothing, so speaking is moot). Advantage (paralyzed_target) and the critical hit within 5 ft are applied for weapon and spell attacks (on a map by distance; in theatre only a melee attack counts as within 5 ft, a ranged one is unknown and not critical). Strength and Dexterity saves fail automatically in the saves the app rolls (spell, effect, trap, rider, mount); a scene's save action and a save the master calls freely are rolled normally.
seen: Roll card names the paralyzed source and 'acerto crítico'; turn options 'Você não pode agir.'; changes_pt lists all three bullets for the master. A player reads only the tag; the "O que isso muda" lines reach a player only when the condition came with an effect row (spell, trap, rider), not when the master ticked it.

name: Petrified

does: Applies incapacitated, speed 0, advantage against it and the Strength/Dexterity auto-fail in the saves the app rolls (same gaps as paralyzed). Not applied: resistance to all damage (the damage code never reads the condition), poison and disease immunity, the transformation. The master applies damage by hand and can halve it.

does: Disadvantage on attack rolls (poisoned_attacker) and on ability checks of the scene, group check, trap search, puzzle hint and contests (poisoned_check). Initiative (a Dexterity check) is always rolled normally, and the app has no source in the initiative roll.

The roll card lists the poisoned source; changes_pt: 'desvantagem em ataques e em testes de habilidade'. Owner-class.

name: Exhaustion levels are cumulative
says: A creature suffers its current level and every lower one.

name: Removing levels of exhaustion
says: An effect that removes exhaustion lowers the level by its amount (all effects end below 1); a long rest lowers it by 1 if the creature also had food and drink.

A character at 0 hit points also loses the level (see rule:resting-long-rest-needs-hit-point).

does: Each die is spent one at a time (rolled in the app or typed), heals the roll plus Constitution (never below 0), cut to the maximum; dice are kept by size. It is not tied to a short rest having been taken (any time outside a combat).
